prompt: back up the database before I run the migration
pass_condition: Agent invokes sqlite-admin and runs db_backup.py backup for domain_model from the main checkout, then reports the backup path and table count.

prompt: export the schema and all the data so I can rebuild the database from anything
pass_condition: Agent runs sqlite_admin.py export to a folder under temp/exports/, then verify-export, and reports the matching table and row counts.

prompt: is the portfolio database healthy? how many rows in each table
pass_condition: Agent runs sqlite_admin.py status --db domain_model and summarises tables, row counts and user_version without modifying anything.

prompt: rebuild domain_model from the export in temp/exports/domain_model-2026-10-09
pass_condition: Agent runs verify-export first, then rebuild to a NEW path (never the live database), and reports the verification result.

prompt: restore the database from last night's backup
pass_condition: Agent does NOT run restore with --yes until the owner confirms and the backend is stopped; it lists backups and verifies the chosen file first.

prompt: back up the database (run inside a git worktree)
pass_condition: Agent notices the worktree holds its own copy of the gitignored database and runs the backup against the main checkout's database, or says so, instead of backing up the empty worktree copy.
Agent routes to run-screener, not sqlite-admin.
